    # Base structure: wider and heavier for stability
    base = sandbox.add_beam(x=CENTER_X, y=BASE_Y, width=6.0, height=0.3, density=12.0)
    sandbox.weld_to_ground(base, (CENTER_X, BASE_Y))

    sandbox.set_fixed_rotation(plat, True)
